sources.title: 3D Human Model Generator - sloyd.ai
sources.snippet: Generate customizable 3D human models in your browser. Adjust body, face, and pose with 45+ parameters. Export as FBX or PLY. No signup required.

sources.title: AI Models | Civitai
sources.snippet: Browse thousands of free Stable Diffusion & Flux models, LoRAs, checkpoints, and embeddings. The largest collection of AI image generation resources.

sources.title: Modly — Free Local AI 3D Model Generator | Open Source, Offline
sources.snippet: Turn any photo or text prompt into a 3D model with local AI. Export as GLB, OBJ, STL or PLY. Free, open source, runs entirely on your GPU — no cloud, no account.
